headline: Dumpster licensing and rat control, Cummings School Warming Center after-action report, and street harassment near Prescott Street and School Street.
summary: Items cover rat control and dumpster licensing, a report on the 2025-2026 Cummings School Winter Warming Center, and street harassment near the Warming Center. Also listed are a resolution on meeting spaces for Alcoholics Anonymous and monthly updates on homelessness.
items: Resolution in support of meeting spaces for Alcoholics Anonymous, by Councilor Link and Councilor McLaughlin
Public comment from Barbara Phillips about the Warming Center
Order asking the Director of Public Health to update the Council on dumpster license registration, enforcement, and rat exclusion, by Councilor Wheeler, Councilor Hardt, and Councilor Sait
Report from the Director of Emergency Management on the 2025-2026 Cummings School Winter Warming Center After Action Report and Improvement Plan
Resolution asking the Director of Health and Human Services to discuss street harassment on Prescott Street, School Street, and near the Warming Center, by Councilor Strezo
Public comment from the Gilman Square Neighborhood Council about McGrath Boulevard, referred for recommendation
Resolution asking the Administration for monthly updates on progress toward addressing homelessness in Somerville, by Councilor McLaughlin and Councilor Davis
